title: Remove and Support Gripper for a Tipper Using Visu_MCP_Dual (Cycle Stop + Jog) and LOTO
summary: Prepare a tipper for gripper removal by stopping the current cycle, enabling manual jogging on the operator station HMI (Visu_MCP_Dual), positioning the gripper at the specified location, optionally supporting the carriages if the gripper is moved off home, and performing LOTO at the station e-panel. Confirm the correct gripper selection (left vs right) before proceeding.
when_to_use: Use when you must remove a tipper gripper and need to stop the cycle, jog the tipper/gripper to the required location, mechanically support the carriages if the gripper is moved from home, and apply LOTO at the station e-panel before removal.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a general tipper fault troubleshooting guide; it is specifically for gripper removal preparation (stop/jog/LOTO/left-right verification).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform HMI actions (CYCLE STOP, JOG, axis movement) and execute LOTO at the station e-panel as required for gripper removal preparation.
safety_notes: Caution: Components may be heavy. Use caution when lifting (gripper replacement section includes this caution).
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper operator station HMI access to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen
LOTO capability at the station e-panel ("Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" referenced by the manual)
Required tools for later removal: 2.5-mm, 3-mm, 5-mm, 6-mm hex wrenches; Loctite®

system_preconditions: Tipper is at the operator station and can be stopped from the operator station HMI
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure (referenced as "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2)

steps.title: Navigate to the Visu_MCP_Dual screen on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Access the operator station controls needed to stop the cycle and enable jogging for gripper positioning.
steps.instruction: At the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
steps.expected_result: The operator station HMI is displaying the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen is visible and ready for operator inputs (CYCLE STOP and JOG controls are accessible on that screen).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate or access the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen, or the required controls are not available.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot access the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen needed to control the tipper.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: At the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.

steps.title: Stop the cycle and enable manual jogging
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper cycle is stopped and manual control is enabled so the gripper can be positioned safely.
steps.instruction: Press "CYCLE STOP" to stop the cycle, then press "JOG" to manually control the tipper.
steps.expected_result: The cycle is stopped and the HMI is in a state where manual jogging is enabled after pressing JOG.
steps.healthy_condition: After pressing CYCLE STOP, the cycle is no longer running; after pressing JOG, manual control is available for moving the tipper/gripper.
steps.failure_condition: The cycle does not stop, or manual control does not engage after pressing CYCLE STOP and JOG.

actions.label: Cycle stop
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the cycle

actions.label: Enable jog
actions.exact_action: press JOG to manually control the tipper

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the cycle does not stop after pressing CYCLE STOP.
Stop and escalate if manual control does not engage after pressing JOG.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the cycle, then press JOG to manually control the tipper.

The Tipper Machine Control Panel ("Visu_MCP_Dual" screen) has buttons that control tipper movement... The JOG button allows the operator to manually control the location and position of the end effector and gripper... The CYCLE STOP button stops the tipper operation cycle when the system is in "Auto" mode.

steps.title: Jog the gripper to the desired location using the axis buttons for the corresponding tipper
steps.purpose: Position the gripper at the specified location required for gripper removal.
steps.instruction: Use the axis buttons for the corresponding tipper to move the gripper to the desired location.
steps.expected_result: The gripper is positioned at the desired location as a result of axis button jogging.
steps.healthy_condition: The gripper moves in response to axis button inputs for the intended tipper and reaches the target location without unexpected behavior.
steps.failure_condition: The gripper does not move as expected when using the axis buttons, or it cannot be positioned to the required location.

actions.label: Jog to target
actions.exact_action: Use the axis buttons for the corresponding tipper to move the gripper to the desired location

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the gripper cannot be positioned to the required location using the axis buttons.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Use the axis buttons for the corresponding tipper to move the gripper to the desired location.

steps.title: Support carriages with screws if the gripper is moved from its home position
steps.purpose: Prevent carriage drop or unsafe movement when the gripper is not in its home position.
steps.instruction: If the gripper is moved from its home position, thread screws into the threaded holes in the column to support the carriages between the pair or holes.
steps.expected_result: Carriages are mechanically supported by screws threaded into the threaded holes in the column (between the pair or holes) after moving off home.
steps.healthy_condition: Screws are threaded into the specified threaded holes in the column and the carriages are supported in the intended location.
steps.failure_condition: You moved the gripper from home but did not thread screws into the threaded holes to support the carriages.

actions.label: Thread support screws
actions.exact_action: thread screws into the threaded holes in the column to support the carriages between the pair or holes

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the gripper was moved from home and carriage support screws were not installed as required.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: NOTE: If the gripper is moved from its home position, thread screws into the threaded holes in the column to support the carriages between the pair or holes.

steps.title: LOTO the tipper at the station e-panel
steps.purpose: De-energize and secure the tipper for safe gripper removal.
steps.instruction: LOTO the tipper at the station e-panel (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is locked out at the station e-panel using the required lockout/tagout points/procedure.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is applied at the station e-panel for the tipper before proceeding to gripper removal.
steps.failure_condition: LOTO is not applied at the station e-panel before gripper removal.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper at the station e-panel (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2)

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if LOTO at the station e-panel is not completed before gripper removal.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: LOTO the tipper at the station e-panel (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

steps.title: Verify the correct gripper selection (left gripper vs right gripper)
steps.purpose: Ensure you are preparing the correct side for gripper removal to avoid working on the wrong gripper.
steps.instruction: Verify the correct gripper has been selected (i.e., left gripper or right gripper).
steps.expected_result: You confirm whether the left gripper or right gripper is selected for the removal work.
steps.healthy_condition: The operator can state which gripper (left vs right) is selected and matches the intended removal target.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confirm the correct gripper selection (left vs right) before proceeding.

actions.label: Confirm left/right gripper
actions.exact_action: Verify the correct gripper has been selected (i.e., left gripper or right gripper).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the operator cannot confirm the correct gripper selection (left vs right) before proceeding.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Verify the correct gripper has been selected (i.e., left gripper or right gripper).

success_criteria: Gripper is positioned at the desired location using the axis buttons for the corresponding tipper.
If moved from home, screws are threaded into the threaded holes in the column to support the carriages.
LOTO is applied at the station e-panel for the tipper.
Operator confirms correct gripper selection (left vs right).
healthy_conditions: CYCLE STOP stops the tipper operation cycle and JOG enables manual control.
Axis jogging moves the gripper to the intended location.
Carriages are mechanically supported with screws when gripper is moved from home.
LOTO is applied at the station e-panel before removal.
failure_conditions: Cycle does not stop after pressing CYCLE STOP.
Manual control does not engage after pressing JOG.
Gripper cannot be positioned to the required location.
Gripper moved from home without installing carriage support screws.
LOTO not applied at the station e-panel.
Operator cannot confirm correct left vs right gripper selection.
escalation_guidance: If CYCLE STOP does not stop the cycle or JOG does not enable manual control, stop and escalate.
If you cannot confirm left vs right gripper selection, stop and escalate.
If LOTO at the station e-panel cannot be completed, stop and escalate.
